text:
jin: hi team - new hire question. running the dev compose on my M1 Mac and redis keeps refusing connections from my host app. compose maps 6379:6379 but `redis-cli -h localhost -p 6379` times out. any known M1 quirks?

harper: welcome! unlikely to be M1-specific. can you paste your compose service and redis.conf if you're mounting one?

jin: sure, compose snippet:
```yaml
services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7.0
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - ./redis/redis.conf:/usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf:ro
    command: ["redis-server", "/usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf"]
```
redis.conf (first lines):
```
bind 127.0.0.1
protected-mode yes
requirepass devpass
```

ops-bot: ops-bot posted: "container redis (id: a1b2c) restarted 3 times"

liam: two immediate issues: 1) `bind 127.0.0.1` will make redis only listen on the container localhost, not the external interface. 2) `protected-mode yes` + `bind 127.0.0.1` will block external connections. change to `bind 0.0.0.0` and `protected-mode no` if you want host access in dev.

jin: changed bind to 0.0.0.0 and protected-mode no, but still connection refused. `docker logs` shows: `*** FATAL CONFIG FILE ERROR ***\nReading the configuration file, at line 1, characters 1-13: Unsupported or invalid directive`

sam: that error usually means redis.conf has weird bytes or windows line endings. on mac check `file -I redis/redis.conf` and `sed -n '1,3p' redis/redis.conf | od -c | head` to inspect.

jin: `file -I` returned `text/plain; charset=us-ascii`. but when i `od -c` i see `\r\n` endings. i actually edited the file in VSCode on a corporate windows machine earlier and pulled the repo on mac.

harper: yeah CRLF can break redis parser. run `dos2unix redis/redis.conf` or `tr -d '\r' < redis/redis.conf > redis/redis.fixed.conf` and update compose to mount that.

jin: ran `dos2unix`, restarted container. redis now logs `Ready to accept connections` and docker ps shows the port mapping. `redis-cli -h localhost -p 6379 -a devpass ping` returns `PONG` :tada:

liam: nice! two small doc suggestions for onboarding: 1) if you mount custom configs call out CRLF pitfalls when files were edited on Windows; 2) prefer named volumes for data dir to avoid macos permission / fsevents issues:
```yaml
volumes:
  redis_data:
services:
  redis:
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
```

jin: will open a small PR to add that. quick question: is `requirepass` + `protected-mode no` an OK pattern for local dev?

harper: fine for local but prefer auth in URL for apps: `redis://:devpass@localhost:6379/0`. never do that in prod.

ops-bot: ops-bot posted: "welcome message sent to jin - checklist: IDE, git, docker, slack"

jin: thanks everyone! fixed and learned about dos2unix. ping me if you want me to add examples to the onboarding doc.

sam: welcome aboard and thanks for improving docs :smile:
